storyTitle: Vite + React client with API proxy
description: As a developer, I need the client dev server running with a proxy to Express so the UI can call the API without CORS issues.
acceptanceCriteria: client/ has Vite + React + TypeScript configured
Vite dev server runs on port 5173
Root App component renders a visible heading (e.g. 'TodoApp')
Client successfully reaches /api/health through the proxy
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
guidance:
The client/ directory is currently empty (just a placeholder dir with no files). Scaffold it as a Vite + React + TypeScript project inside app/client/. Key patterns from prior work: npm workspaces root is app/, devDependencies are hoisted to app/node_modules/ — install React/Vite deps via `npm install --workspace=client` from app/. Create app/client/package.json, app/client/vite.config.ts (with server.proxy: { '/api': 'http://localhost:3000' }), app/client/tsconfig.json, app/client/index.html, app/client/src/main.tsx, and app/client/src/App.tsx. The App component must render a visible heading (e.g.

TodoApp

) and on mount call fetch('/api/health') to confirm the proxy works. Update app/package.json scripts to include the client in typecheck and add a client dev script. After scaffolding, use the dev-browser skill to verify the UI renders the heading and the proxy health check succeeds. Ensure tsc --noEmit passes in app/client/.
reasoning: US-002 is the highest-priority incomplete story (priority 2); its dependency US-001 passed cleanly. Skipping sensors because the previous story passed with no warnings and this is only the second story.
